note: checkCompile cases: args = [{indexPath, indexText, outputPath, outputText, files: {path: text}, changed?, exclusions?: {texts, paths}}]; expected holds a subset of {status, errors, scenes, checked, outputParagraphs, excluded, unmatched}. Each unmatched row is [text, missing, sourceCount, outputCount, ["path:line"], uncertain, hint]. Cases with a "function" field call that export of the same module (parseSceneOrder, reportPath, splitParagraphs) and compare the whole result.
